data.title: 妮姆芙 · 客厅沙发的苹果糖晃脚依偎
data.description: 午后明媚的日式客厅沙发上，穿着水手服的妮姆芙双手捧着一颗晶莹红润的苹果糖小口舔着。双脚一晃一晃，小脑袋轻轻靠在你的手臂上，透明的双翼微微舒展，满溢着被宠溺的幸福。
data.location: sunny Japanese suburban living room with tatami mats
data.action: sitting on living room sofa licking a glossy red candy apple, swinging legs rhythmically, leaning her small head against partner arm while demanding pats
data.lighting: warm peaceful afternoon sunshine flooding through glass doors
data.mood: cute spoiled pet-girlfriend charm, sweet domestic innocence, relaxing afternoon
data.promptProse: Sitting on a sunny sofa eating a red candy apple, Nymph swings her legs happily, leaning her head against partner arm with fluttering wings.
data.animaCaption: Nymph eating candy apple and leaning on partner on sunny sofa.
